name: Platinum Adventure
author: Jerry4
description: Enter the bottom of the portal at 50% to skip the 1x speed portal and stay at 3x speed. Jump over the blue pad at 55% (you want your icon to be close to hitting the platform at 56%) to fall to the floor. At 74%, play through the gameplay as the 3x speed robot. At 82%, you will enter a ball portal. Play the level normally from there.
